capabilities: Sync vault files across devices via CouchDB replication
Encrypt notes end-to-end with AES-256/HKDF before upload
Filter synced content by file type and gitignore-style ignore patterns
Queue offline changes, auto-reconnect, and show a live sync status indicator
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The managed backend needs a license key from mdfriday.com while self-hosting via CouchDB or hugoverse is free; a detailed section discloses all external network requests and why native fetch is used inside the PouchDB replication adapter.
intentEvidence: builds on the battle-tested Self-hosted LiveSync core and adds what it lacks
motivation: The author wanted to keep the LiveSync replication core but remove the server setup burden by adding a managed, open-source backend activated with a license key.
problem: Obsidian's Sync is paid and closed-source, while free options like Self-hosted LiveSync require manually provisioning and maintaining your own CouchDB server.
